prompt: A witch village on stilts in the swamp.

card.name: Stilt Hollow

site.text: A village on stilts in the swamp, huts and platforms raised above murky water on timber piles, linked by rope bridges and boardwalks.

style.text: Witchy swamp look: dark oak and spruce, mangrove, moss, vines, lanterns and soul lanterns, mushrooms, cauldrons, candles, green and purple glow.

purpose.text: A witch village: a coven's home with potion brewing, herb gathering and spell work.

card.interpretation: A swamp village of witch huts raised on stilts over the water, medium size. I read the style as a rustic, mossy, dark-wood witchy look, and the purpose as a coven's home base with brewing and ritual spaces. It uses existing swamp terrain, so nothing is reshaped.
assumptions: Uses existing swamp water and land rather than sculpting.
No backstory given, so none added.
Rustic chosen as nearest style template, with witchy details in text.

program.notes: Largest stilt house, tall crooked roof, cauldron on the porch, brewing stand and bookshelves inside, hanging lanterns.
Small stilt huts with bed, cauldron, flower pots, and a ladder down to the water.
Rows of brewing stands, cauldrons, barrels and shelves of potion bottles.
Hanging herbs, mushrooms and vines, farmland planter boxes on the deck.
Open raised deck with soul lanterns and candles, a ring of cauldrons.
Boats moored under the stilts, fishing racks.
Tall stilt lookout with a lantern.
